Separate trained magecraft, Church countermeasures, and inherent anomalous ability where comparison would otherwise mislead. Use a supported descriptive scale or an explicitly bounded graph model. Keep today's agility, endurance, precision, and trained competence independent of MBTI. Do not simply reduce high scores until shapes look balanced. Decision needed: Agreement on what the graph should compare. Specific training histories, failure limits, and supernatural costs remain open. R14. Supporting characters need decisions that belong to them Evidence: Tien is strongly defined by serving Helena and opposing Kyrien; Myka's danger and eventual success have more definition than her own decisions; the Cardiff disagreement identifies moral incompatibility without establishing the act that makes it unavoidable. Broad statements about competence or morality cannot yet carry those scenes. Proposed action: Develop one consequential choice, one dependency, and one credible limit for each character when their next scene is written. For Cardiff, identify the specific solution Mikhail accepts that Lynleit cannot accept. For Myka, establish something she does that affects her survival and later recruitment. Preserve specialist distinctions rather than giving every supporting character the protagonists' skills. Decision needed: Concrete author choices. The audit should not invent Mikhail's ethics, Myka's curriculum, or Tien's private loyalties. R15. Relationship direction needs evidence across ordinary work Evidence: Sherie and Felix's confirmed gradual direction is richer than the professional encounters currently drafted. Much intimacy guidance describes anticipated behavior. A hypothetical response to Sherie's hurt is not yet a scene. Lynleit and Kyrien's rescue and secrecy milestones are better documented than their mundane repeated contact. Proposed action: Give future main-plot scenes space for small, specific interactions that accumulate. Track established encounters separately from intended development. Preserve Felix's attachment to Lynleit while Sherie acquires significance of her own, and keep Lynleit's duty primary. Do not add a confession simply to complete an audit checklist. Decision needed: Approval to develop particular encounters, with chronology kept open where it is not fixed. R16. Foundational terms need a shorter route into the setting Evidence: Definitions of magic, magecraft, miracles, Holumns, identity, and suppression are distributed across World and Docs. Human singularity appears in Lester's account without a short local explanation of what the phrase permits the reader to understand. Institutional interpretations can sound like universal physical laws when read in isolation. Proposed action: Provide a concise entry point with links to owning definitions. Distinguish observed effects, institutional doctrine, and unanswered ontology. Cross-link existing explanations before adding another large foundational essay. Move public development prompts such as the Magiarchy page's Awaiting definition section into the editorial ledgers, while retaining honest statements about unknown phenomena. Preserve unknown mechanisms rather than filling them with invented technical language. Decision needed: Approval for organization and clearer wording; any new metaphysical definition requires author confirmation. UI and reading experience R17. Fix the two confirmed intermediate-width overflows Evidence: At 1024 pixels in both engines, the Director's House heading has about 199 pixels of content in a 162-pixel column. The Holumn definition's first explanation exceeds its local column as well. The house keeps a three-column hero until a 950-pixel breakpoint; its fixed side columns and padding leave the title too narrow. The Holumn layout nests another two-column grid inside an already constrained panel. Proposed action: Collapse these compositions according to available content width, reduce unsuitable fixed minimums, and allow long text to wrap. Test the full interval around the breakpoints and browser zoom. Preserve the distinct page designs and flat palette. Decision needed: Implementation approval only. Neither issue was fixed in this audit. R18. Restore visible life-period context to profile artwork Evidence: The portrait carousel updates Arc information in image alt text, thumbnail titles, and a screen-reader-only status. A sighted touch user cannot reliably identify the displayed Arc 2 artwork from those labels. Catalog cards do display an Arc label. Proposed action: Add a small visible era label only when relevant, without restoring arrow buttons, image counters, a large overlay background, or obstructed artwork. Keep image-half taps, dragging, swiping, and thumbnails. Decision needed: Implementation approval and placement preference only if the author wants to choose it. R19. Remove misleading empty choices and distinguish music concepts Evidence: All 33 current Gallery records use unspecified location, while the location selector still offers several named places with no matching images. Music has one playable recording and four concepts; the category architecture now matches Characters, but concepts still occupy the same prominent browsing space as playable work. Proposed action: Derive available filter choices and counts from records, without inventing locations. Keep future metadata support. Offer a straightforward playable-only option or separate concepts from recordings, retaining the custom banner player and both downloads. Do not relabel a concept as available. Decision needed: Approval for filtering improvements; keeping concepts visible by default is a design choice, not a canon question. R20. Reduce navigation work in long readers Evidence: A Chapter reader places the full horizontal story timeline before the actual chapter. Long documents and profiles require substantial scrolling; the desktop layout also has an independently scrolling content pane and a Page notes column. These structures work, but they compete with sustained reading. Proposed action: Offer a compact or collapsible timeline in reader views, retain the full timeline in catalogs, add useful section navigation, and preserve back navigation and scroll position. Improve the use of the right column without adding a permanent left sidebar. Do not remove the timeline or breadcrumbs. Decision needed: Approval for reader-focused design work. A default reading mode should be chosen together with R07. R21. Finish accessibility testing beyond visual correctness Evidence: Existing tests cover menu focus and several interactions, but do not establish complete screen-reader behavior, contrast, every tooltip dismissal route, map rearrangement without a pointer, or physical iPhone gesture behavior. The local WebKit run is not native Safari certification. Proposed action: Test F/M/S notes with keyboard and assistive technology, verify text contrast and touch targets, test map and portrait interaction under zoom and reduced motion, and confirm that drag gestures do not trap vertical scrolling. Add only the controls required to make the existing interactions usable. Decision needed: Approval for the accessibility pass. A physical Safari check requires access to the target environment; until then, report that limit explicitly. Writer workflow and cohesion R22. Make the ledgers reflect evidence and actual unresolved decisions Evidence: The contradictions ledger records no unresolved contradiction despite the source drift in R01 and the boundary problem requiring review in R02. The capability ledger already holds several concerns that have not changed the graph. Confidence percentages help scan the questions but do not explain what evidence would close them. Proposed action: Register verified conflicts after approval, link them to their owning sources and required follow-up surfaces, and group questions by the decision that would answer them. Retain the required confidence and resolution bars. Separate ordinary missing information, deliberate mysteries, and genuinely incompatible statements. Do not resolve a deliberate contradiction in Lester's existence as though it were a continuity error. Decision needed: Approval for ledger maintenance. Answers remain the author's unless already established. R23. Reduce duplicated explanations and conflicting maintenance guidance Evidence: Suppression doctrine and basic ontology are explained in several World and Docs records. They serve different readers, but repeated full explanations increase drift risk. The maintenance charter still describes entity links as ordinary prose until hover, while the recorded design preference is that they remain ordinary-looking in every state, with usable keyboard focus. Large shared style sections and repeated navigation markup also make local adjustments hard to reason about. Proposed action: Keep one owning definition and concise contextual explanations elsewhere. Reconcile guidance wording, document the owner of each recurring component, and refactor only where tests demonstrate equivalent behavior. Do not force the individually designed World pages into one template or undertake a framework migration. Decision needed: Approval for focused maintenance and source consolidation, not a site rebuild. R24. Extend regression checks to the failures this audit found Evidence: Existing checks passed while the 1024-pixel text overflows and Lester's foundation drift remained. A single explicitly registered v1 document also exposed a mismatch between search URL generation and the expected version URL during today's integration; the new reference follows the existing implicit-v1 convention instead. Proposed action: Add tests for internal text overflow at intermediate widths, explicit single-version documents, visible artwork era labels, and selected cross-record canon invariants. Retain current checks for snapshots, search history, links, gradients, masonry, and mobile navigation. Keep prose judgment and unresolved canon out of false pass/fail assertions. Decision needed: Implementation approval only for tests and demonstrated defects; do not turn a hypothesis into a test that forces it to become canon. Recommended order after approval 1. Consistency and verified defects: R01-R05, R17-R19, R22-R24, excluding questions that need an author decision. 2. Reading and knowledge structure: R06-R08, R11, R16, R20-R21. 3. Prose, capability, and scene development: R09-R10, R12-R15, with a bounded plan for each revision. The decisions most likely to need the author directly are the archive's spoiler policy, the future of The Name Left Behind, reciprocal favourite-student status, exact chronology still left open, capability limits, the concrete Cardiff moral conflict, and any new scene proposed to demonstrate a relationship or a talent. Approval of cleanup alone must not be interpreted as permission to decide those facts. Archive Review

entries.title: Bone Archive: Development and Source
entries.subtitle: World Development
entries.text: Bone Archive: Development and Source World Development The song-inspired Holumn direction, recovery costs, surviving bargains, and limits of the comparison with Lester. Bone Archive: Development and Source Approved world direction The author approved integrating the Bone Archive concept into MAGIARCHY on 14 September 2026. HI-008 owns the Holumn record. It preserves experiences without a continuous place for them in a person's surviving history. Their traces can be bodily as well as remembered. The opening incident is an officer stepping aside before a shot, then finding a scar where the bullet would have entered. It has no assigned character, institution, location, Arc, or Chapter. Begin with this person's evidence rather than a comprehensive explanation of the Archive. Recovery and attachment Recovered experience can supply a response or knowledge, accompanied by the suffering through which it was acquired. Remembering how to escape a burning room may include remembering death there. This is a cost-bearing phenomenon, not a dependable way to undo a mistake or acquire any desired skill. Preserve the possibility that an affected person wants to keep the experience. A remembered loved one may be a stranger in the present; real relationships can become less familiar. The person can be proud, complicit, angry, or protective of the life others want them to relinquish. No particular victim or relationship has yet been chosen for those developments. Records and responsibility The devil's receipts inspire surviving records of bargains whose making cannot be recovered. An authentic agreement and authentic evidence of wrongdoing can coexist. The agreement does not automatically establish that its promised alternative was true, or absolve someone for fulfilling it. A Church investigation is a possible way to stage this conflict. No trial, doctrine, verdict, victim, or investigator has been assigned. Keep devil and angel as the source speaker's terms until the author establishes an in-world referent. Natalia and Lester Natalia could investigate the Archive, recognize a resemblance to Lester's contradiction, and discover the limits of the comparison. This remains a development route. It does not establish an encounter, experiment, new expertise, or personal memory for her. Lester is not explained by discarded timelines or recovered memories. His origin remains beyond a conventional causal account. The Archive must not become a mechanism for repairing his biography. Musical source Title: Bone Archive (Rewind) Author-described sound: Cellos, fast church organs, deep EDM bass, minor chords, and a fast tempo. The author wrote intuitively for atmosphere, without a predetermined story or explanation. No audio file was supplied for this integration. The recurring bodily and archival imagery suggests experience recorded in the person rather than a readable supernatural library. The refrain's possessiveness suggests someone defending their attachment to the condition. These readings inspired the approved direction; the lyrics do not independently establish facts about MAGIARCHY. The song's speaker remains unidentified. A repeated future, debt measured in hours, and divine figures belong to the lyric voice, not to a settled cosmology or a guaranteed prediction mechanism. Atmospheric options The contrast between ceremony and speed can guide a later scene: testimony recited too quickly, a ritual continuing after its purpose has been forgotten, or a remembered event arriving before the present seems ready for it. These remain optional scene approaches. The music's rhythm is not an activation condition, and a sung rewind is not proof that time reverses. Audit and limits The Nasu-inspired advisory audit favors physical evidence before explanation, useful recovery coupled to cost, personal attachment that complicates rescue, and records that deepen moral disagreement rather than resolve it. This is the project's framework, not participation or endorsement by Kinoko Nasu. Do not invent a keeper, storage building, bone relic, access rite, guaranteed countermeasure, unlimited forecasts, or a causal tie to the Spill. The Questions ledger owns the unresolved choices. Character capability, behavior, and relationship records should change only when a particular character's involvement is established. Author's Desk

entries.text: Character Behaviour Audit · v1 Writer's Character Reference Advisory scene notes combining established characterization, physical circumstance, sex, social experience, and MBTI function emphasis without turning broad gender patterns into canon. Character Behaviour Audit This writer-facing record tests whether a reaction feels specific to the character who performs it. The notes combine established history, physical circumstances, sex, social expectations, and MBTI function emphasis. They are possibilities for the author to accept, reject, or revise. They are not canon until they enter a story record. How the audit works Begin with what the character already wants, fears, notices, and knows how to do. Use sex and social experience where the scene makes them materially relevant: physical leverage, clothing, public danger, expectations learned in childhood, or the way another person reads the character. Use MBTI functions to shape attention and decision-making. They do not excuse an action or predetermine it. A useful note creates a more precise choice. A broad claim that any man or woman would behave the same way should be discarded. Story-pressure notes identify a possible payoff or image. They remain separate from confirmed scene facts. river-operation The river operation nameless-street The Nameless Street relationships-under-pressure Relationships under pressure long-term-inheritance Long-term inheritance academy-crisis The Academy crisis cardiff-venture The Cardiff venture doom-address Doom Has an Address river-lynleit river-operation female Lynleit ENFJ with strong Ni Once Lynleit is ashore, the feeling of hands holding her down may linger even while she tries to give orders. Her later complaint about the jacket can be petty and heartfelt: she liked it and could not save it. the-empty-boats-beneath-the-bridge the-boat-beneath-the-bridge river-kyrien river-operation male Kyrien ISTP lean Keep Kyrien's answer literal and brief. He knows what he saw and chooses not to say it. His officer upbringing and watchfulness can appear in his attention to the search on the other bank. the-empty-boats-beneath-the-bridge the-boat-beneath-the-bridge river-maren river-operation female Maren Type unknown Maren is a trained officer, not a weaker swimmer. The horror lies in losing ownership of her own movement when hands seize her legs. Once ashore, a short sensory statement is more credible than a theory: she knows what fingers felt like, but does not claim to know who they belonged to. Anger or embarrassment at having needed to be hauled over the wall may surface after the immediate shock. the-empty-boats-beneath-the-bridge the-boat-beneath-the-bridge river-reiner river-operation male Reiner ISTJ with strong Si and Te Reiner's greater build makes him the practical anchor for Maren and Ivo, but the river prevents strength from solving the whole problem. He is likely to convert fear into tasks: secure the person, reach the wall, count the team, check the line. His later guilt would appear as stricter procedure and repeated equipment checks rather than a broad confession. the-empty-boats-beneath-the-bridge the-boat-beneath-the-bridge river-felix river-operation male Felix ESFP with strong Se and Fi Remaining ashore should frustrate Felix because his most valued people descend without him. His role is still decisive. He keeps the cameras frozen, hears the failure before he can see it, abandons the van at the correct moment, and turns a communications fallback into a physical rescue line. A joke after the extraction can be an attempt to restore ordinary human rhythm, not proof that he took the danger lightly. the-empty-boats-beneath-the-bridge the-boat-beneath-the-bridge river-blue-flame river-operation story Blue flame under the river Story-pressure suggestion The blue flame can expose the scale of the horror without an explanation. Hands burning in blue beneath the surface would briefly illuminate different ages, sizes, and states of decay before the river closes over them again. The image would let the reader understand that Lynleit is fighting accumulated dead rather than a single submerged attacker. the-empty-boats-beneath-the-bridge the-boat-beneath-the-bridge pressure-lynleit-interrogation relationships-under-pressure female Lynleit ENFJ with strong Ni, MSF duty primary Lynleit's concealed knowledge that Kyrien nearly harmed her gives the interrogation a personal edge, but she does not make the injury the purpose of the scene. Her MSF responsibility and anticipation of a larger threat remain decisive. The private anger should appear through unusually exact questions, controlled distance, or refusal to explain herself rather than flirtation or an emotional confession. after-the-failed-attempt interrogation-after-the-failed-attempt pressure-card-tells relationships-under-pressure story Cards and physical tells Approved sexual-tension pattern Keep the games brief and embedded in operational downtime. Kyrien should win more often through technical play, while Lynleit gains ground by reading him. Their attention becomes sexual because hands, breathing, gaze, and proximity begin to distract them, not because either character starts performing romance. Lynleit notices the intrusion and returns to the mission. the-empty-boats-beneath-the-bridge the-boat-beneath-the-bridge pressure-kyrien-voluntary-stay relationships-under-pressure male Kyrien ISTP lean, officer ethics and autonomy Kyrien's decision to remain must occur when departure is genuinely possible and Lynleit's original authority has lost practical force. He is unlikely to explain the choice romantically. Staying, accepting the danger, and reopening contact are enough to separate voluntary loyalty from the vigilance of a coerced asset. the-first-lines-back-into-msf pressure-kyrien-battle-reward relationships-under-pressure male Kyrien ISTP lean, competitive drive and paternal inheritance The answer should remain immediate and unadorned. Kyrien does not reassure Lynleit or make her the reward because he experiences the fight as a chance to test himself. The useful ambiguity lies in what he does not examine: choosing a battle repeatedly places him beside the same woman, even while he continues to describe the motive as his own. because-theres-a-battle-to-be-fought pressure-mikhail-aftermath relationships-under-pressure story The argument after Mikhail Approved relationship-pressure beat The argument remains about Kyrien exposing Felix and Reiner. Physical awareness belongs only in the delayed step apart and should not soften either position. Kyrien remains to help without apologizing, while Lynleit returns immediately to the institutional problem he has worsened. mikhail-discovers-the-breach nameless-lynleit nameless-street female Lynleit ENFJ with strong Ni The crying girl works as a lure because Lynleit notices a vulnerable person and assumes responsibility before she can test the situation. This does not require a general claim that women are more nurturing. Her Fe-oriented leadership, strong symbolic intuition, and experience of being watched make the trap personal. Afterward she may be angrier that the street used her protective instinct than frightened by the child herself. the-nameless-street the-nameless-street nameless-felix nameless-street male Felix ESFP with strong Se and Fi Felix experiences an ordinary physical emergency while Lynleit experiences the impossible street. His first response is immediate and tactile: get close, make noise, fan her face, check whether she responds. Once she wakes, his familiarity gives him room to tease, but affection should make him notice that her explanation is not a performance. He can believe that something happened without pretending to understand it. the-nameless-street the-nameless-street pressure-helena relationships-under-pressure female Helena ENTJ with strong Te Helena's grievance against Fionn becomes stronger if it includes the private humiliation of being treated as a wife in public and a security risk in his deepest life. Her response remains character-specific: she turns exclusion into a structural problem to remove. She is not dangerous because resentment makes her emotional. She is dangerous because she can organize resentment into policy, access, and succession. fionn-is-eliminated pressure-fionn relationships-under-pressure male Fionn INTJ with strong Ni Fionn can sincerely believe that silence is a form of protection because his identity as father, husband, director, and Magiarch has trained him to equate love with containment. A masculine officer culture may reinforce the habit of carrying danger without asking family to share it. The flaw is not lack of feeling. It is his confidence that private endurance gives him the right to decide what everyone else may know. fionn-is-eliminated pressure-yulia relationships-under-pressure female Yulia ISTJ with strong Si Yulia's decision to follow Hiyu into the park can contain two competing reactions: procedural disgust at the trespass and a familiar expectation that she will be the one who prevents his idea from killing him. As a young woman beside a reckless male friend, she may resent being pushed into practical responsibility while still choosing it. Her care appears in preparation, correction, and staying present rather than an open admission of attraction. students-beyond-the-cordon pressure-hiyu relationships-under-pressure male Hiyu ENTP with strong Ne Hiyu's confidence in an elegant possibility may make the physical risk feel secondary until Yulia reacts to it. His eventual attachment should develop through dependence on the person who makes his ideas survivable. He does not need to become conventionally suave when desire appears. Confusion is more consistent if he recognizes that losing Yulia's company would be intolerable before he recognizes the feeling as romantic. students-beyond-the-cordon inheritance-kyrien long-term-inheritance male Kyrien Probable ISTP moving into command Directing MSF while Lynleit carries the Magiarchate forces Kyrien into a role built around speech, delegation, and institutional patience. His instinct may be to solve pressure alone because that resembles the officer ideal inherited from his father. A believable failure occurs when he withholds a burden that subordinates needed to understand, repeating Fionn's mistake in a different personality. academy-myka-survival academy-crisis story Myka earns the outcome Story-pressure suggestion Myka's eventual first-place graduation should be earned through decisions she makes during the Academy crisis, not granted because Natalia and Kyrien rescue her. Their help can keep her alive or give her access, but at least one decisive discovery, refusal, or use of magecraft should belong to Myka alone and expose a weakness that follows her into MSF. terrors-inside-the-academy academy-kyrien-outsider academy-crisis male Kyrien ISTP lean, non-Magus field operator Kyrien's usefulness inside the Academy should come from seeing an ordinary operational pattern that trained Magi dismiss because they are looking for a magecraft explanation. His outsider status must also cost him: he cannot read magical danger directly and needs Myka or Natalia to interpret what his field instincts expose. terrors-inside-the-academy cardiff-mikhail-capability cardiff-venture male Father Mikhail XNJ lean, Church special envoy and confirmed counter-Magus field operative Mikhail's capability is strongest when the reader learns it through the decisions that keep him alive, not through a summary of techniques. Solitary endurance should expose what his Church training asks him to sacrifice, while at least one successful choice should become the reason Lynleit cannot dismiss his method as simple cruelty. father-mikhails-foreign-venture cardiff-moral-rift cardiff-venture story Two effective methods Nasu audit story-pressure suggestion The moral conflict should not make Lynleit naive or Mikhail a caricature. Each method needs to solve something the other cannot, and each needs a human cost the other recognizes. Their protection of one another remains professional and deliberate even while the disagreement makes later cooperation in Narvea harder. father-mikhails-foreign-venture inheritance-jacket-form long-term-inheritance story The jacket form Story-pressure suggestion The first time the leviathan-hide coat imitates Lynleit's lost suede jacket could occur when the resemblance is emotionally inconvenient. The form would turn an irritable complaint about clothing into posthumous evidence that Fionn noticed more of her ordinary preferences than his secrecy allowed him to say. the-coat-fionn-left-behind inheritance-coat-choice long-term-inheritance story Protection requires a choice Story-pressure suggestion The coat works best as protection with judgment rather than passive armour. Its need to be placed over a specific wound or person forces Lynleit to choose what she covers. Its autonomous form can inconvenience her, but the decision to protect remains hers. the-coat-fionn-left-behind doom-lynleit-method doom-address female Lynleit Canon behavior, ENFJ with strong Ni and MSF duty primary Lynleit rejects the fatal treatment and keeps looking. Her research is competent; discussing its sexual implication with Kyrien is where she becomes evasive. Do not repeat a defense of her leadership after each awkward response. doom-has-an-address doom-has-an-address v1 v2 doom-kyrien-answer doom-address male Kyrien Alternate Version 1 only Kyrien notices that Lynleit is behaving incorrectly, asks one direct question, and does not force the explanation she refuses. His eventual response is physical, deliberate, and chosen after he understands what she is asking. Future intimacy should keep him legible through observation and decision rather than sudden verbal confession. doom-has-an-address doom-has-an-address v1 doom-natalia-teaching doom-address female Natalia Canon behavior, INTP with strong Ti and former professor Natalia checks the premise before offering a solution. Let her former teaching habits interrupt Lynleit's demand for an immediate answer, but give each example a job in the reasoning rather than a second explanation of the whole curse. doom-has-an-address doom-has-an-address v1 v2 doom-mikhail-diagnosis doom-address male Father Mikhail Canon behavior, XNJ lean and Church special envoy Mikhail has records Natalia lacks. Their mixed outcomes give his advice limits before he makes the blunt joke. Preserve both the expertise and the irreverence. doom-has-an-address doom-has-an-address v1 v2 doom-transformation-rule doom-address story Transformation, not intercourse Alternate Version 1 only Future references must preserve the causal distinction established by the chapter. Sex does not possess curative force. The shared curse fractures because an existing reciprocal attachment changes both identities simultaneously and makes the original sympathetic address uncertain. A meaningless encounter or a change affecting only one person would not satisfy the rule. doom-has-an-address doom-has-an-address v1 doom-v2-lynleit-aftermath doom-address female Lynleit after the failed attempt Version 2 behavior, ENFJ with strong Ni and private embarrassment The unread pages and excessive denials already convey Lynleit's continued interest. Let Natalia's question end the exchange without another paragraph decoding her answer. doom-has-an-address doom-has-an-address v2 doom-v2-kyrien-model doom-address male Kyrien without the missing premise Version 2 behavior, ISTP lean and Ti-led observation Kyrien lacks one crucial piece of information. His unanswered question can remain irritating without becoming a demand for confession or a speech about trust. doom-has-an-address doom-has-an-address v2 doom-v2-transformation-rule doom-address story Transformation before completion Superseded Version 2 mechanism In this superseded revision, The incomplete attempt and its aftermath change both identities enough for the curse to lose recognition. Keep the later completed sexual encounter separate; its timing is still unresolved. doom-has-an-address doom-has-an-address v2 doom-v3-lynleit-method doom-address female Lynleit Canon behavior, ENFJ with strong Ni and MSF duty primary Lynleit rejects the fatal treatment and keeps looking. Her research is competent; discussing its sexual implication with Kyrien is where she becomes evasive. Do not repeat a defense of her leadership after each awkward response. doom-has-an-address doom-has-an-address v3 doom-v3-natalia-teaching doom-address female Natalia Canon behavior, INTP with strong Ti and former professor Natalia supplies the ego hypothesis herself, then uses her former teaching routine to make Lynleit work through it. Preserve the examination joke and her pleasure in the unwelcome conclusion. Precision and mischief coexist here. doom-has-an-address doom-has-an-address v3 doom-v3-mikhail-diagnosis doom-address male Father Mikhail Canon behavior, XNJ lean and Church special envoy The long apparent deliberation sets up Mikhail's blunt line. His repeated attempts to stop Lynleit leaving are the escalation, not redundant dialogue. Keep his actual explanation after the interruption. doom-has-an-address doom-has-an-address v3 doom-v3-lynleit-aftermath doom-address female Lynleit after the failed attempt Version 3 behavior, ENFJ with strong Ni and private embarrassment The unread pages and excessive denials already convey Lynleit's continued interest. Let Natalia's question end the exchange without another paragraph decoding her answer. doom-has-an-address doom-has-an-address v3 doom-v3-kyrien-model doom-address male Kyrien without the missing premise Version 3 behavior, ISTP lean and Ti-led observation Kyrien lacks one crucial piece of information. His unanswered question can remain irritating without becoming a demand for confession or a speech about trust. doom-has-an-address doom-has-an-address v3 doom-v3-transformation-rule doom-address story Transformation before completion Confirmed Version 3 mechanism The incomplete attempt changes both identities enough to break recognition. Keep the later completed encounter separate. Do not turn Jung's definition into a real-world claim about supernatural cures. doom-has-an-address doom-has-an-address v3 Character Archive

entries.text: Character Behaviour Audit · v10 Writer's Character Reference Version-scoped church notes for recurring flirting, Lynleit’s irritation, and Reiner’s restraint. Character Behaviour Audit The park's current v2 draft includes an amber Writer notice. Advisory notes describe author-supplied characterization but do not turn the undrafted passage into reader-visible evidence. This writer-facing record tests whether a reaction feels specific to the character who performs it. The notes combine established history, physical circumstances, sex, social expectations, and MBTI function emphasis. They are possibilities for the author to accept, reject, or revise. They are not canon until they enter a story record. How the audit works Begin with what the character already wants, fears, notices, and knows how to do. Use sex and social experience where the scene makes them materially relevant: physical leverage, clothing, public danger, expectations learned in childhood, or the way another person reads the character. Use MBTI functions to shape attention and decision-making. They do not excuse an action or predetermine it. A useful note creates a more precise choice. A broad claim that any man or woman would behave the same way should be discarded. Story-pressure notes identify a possible payoff or image. They remain separate from confirmed scene facts. Doom v7: scope of the current notes The current notes cover Mikhail's mock-liturgical delivery and Lynleit's interrupted composure. They guide performance and reader inference, not a new romantic pairing or a general claim about women. The family connection is now named in dialogue. Her private discomfort is conveyed by the cup, increasingly formal objections, and final threat. The notes distinguish what the scene says from what the reader infers; suggested additions remain advisory. Earlier versions retain their own paragraph anchors and notes. The v7 restoration also lets Mikhail leave one averted glance unremarked. Its story-pressure note addresses the interruption of his teasing, without assigning him a new motive or romantic interest. Restored action beats preserve Lynleit's replies and the timing of the porcelain exchange. Park encounter and prequel direction The park notes concern adult Lynleit and Kyrien: spontaneous closeness after work, private preparation, the familiar flask, and a delayed comic consequence. Arc 0 notes remain tentative formation guidance and do not backdate adult intimate behavior into the younger cast’s school years. The hotel refuge remains nonsexual. Attention and type readings: 12 September 2026 The Cognition and Physical Competence reference preserves the author's answers separately from interpretation. Current notes use suspected INFJ for Lynleit and suspected ENFP for Felix; Kyrien remains an ISTP lead with INTJ open, while Sherie's ENFJ and strong Fe are retained. Historical Chapter-version notes retain their earlier context. Use those answers before a type stereotype. Lynleit consults others without automatically settling her private unease. Kyrien's quiet may contain continuing analysis, not complete understanding. Sherie plays socially even off duty and notices emotional change. Felix can reassure others while privately testing the interpretation he has offered. The hypothetical response to Sherie's hurt is not an established scene. Physical competence belongs to aptitude and acquired skill, not function order. No new paragraph marker is added where there is no actual paragraph or scene to annotate. Only Eyes for You The church interlude now follows the author's recurring setup: Lynleit and Fionn visit churches with Felix and Reiner. Reiner behaves; Felix keeps flirting with the nuns until Lynleit loses patience. Current F, M, and S notes address that accumulated irritation, his instinctive flattering reply, and the straight-person roles of Reiner and the nun. They do not encourage a jealous reading or make Fionn an unrequested commentator. V1 retains its earlier draft and version-scoped notes; v2 supplies the shared scene. Her later complaint about the jacket can be petty and heartfelt: she liked it and could not save it. the-empty-boats-beneath-the-bridge the-boat-beneath-the-bridge river-kyrien river-operation male Kyrien ISTP lean Keep Kyrien's answer literal and brief. He knows what he saw and chooses not to say it. His officer upbringing and watchfulness can appear in his attention to the search on the other bank. the-empty-boats-beneath-the-bridge the-boat-beneath-the-bridge river-maren river-operation female Maren Type unknown Maren is a trained officer, not a weaker swimmer. The horror lies in losing ownership of her own movement when hands seize her legs. Once ashore, a short sensory statement is more credible than a theory: she knows what fingers felt like, but does not claim to know who they belonged to. Anger or embarrassment at having needed to be hauled over the wall may surface after the immediate shock. the-empty-boats-beneath-the-bridge the-boat-beneath-the-bridge river-reiner river-operation male Reiner ISTJ with strong Si and Te Reiner's greater build makes him the practical anchor for Maren and Ivo, but the river prevents strength from solving the whole problem. He is likely to convert fear into tasks: secure the person, reach the wall, count the team, check the line. His later guilt would appear as stricter procedure and repeated equipment checks rather than a broad confession. the-empty-boats-beneath-the-bridge the-boat-beneath-the-bridge river-felix river-operation male Felix Suspected ENFP, habitual alternatives and personal loyalty Remaining ashore should frustrate Felix because his most valued people descend without him. His role is still decisive. He keeps the cameras frozen, hears the failure before he can see it, abandons the van at the correct moment, and turns a communications fallback into a physical rescue line. A joke after the extraction can be an attempt to restore ordinary human rhythm, not proof that he took the danger lightly. the-empty-boats-beneath-the-bridge the-boat-beneath-the-bridge river-blue-flame river-operation story Blue flame under the river Story-pressure suggestion The blue flame can expose the scale of the horror without an explanation. Hands burning in blue beneath the surface would briefly illuminate different ages, sizes, and states of decay before the river closes over them again. entries.text: Character Behaviour Audit · v12 Writer's Character Reference Version-specific guidance for the represented interrogation, family responsibilities, and concealed motives. Character Behaviour Audit The park's current v2 draft includes an amber Writer notice. Advisory notes describe author-supplied characterization but do not turn the undrafted passage into reader-visible evidence. This writer-facing record tests whether a reaction feels specific to the character who performs it. The notes combine established history, physical circumstances, sex, social expectations, and MBTI function emphasis. Each note is a proposal for the author to accept, reject, or revise. Displaying it beside a scene does not make it canon. How the audit works Begin with what the character already wants, fears, notices, and knows how to do. Use sex and social experience where the scene makes them materially relevant: physical leverage, clothing, public danger, expectations learned in childhood, or the way another person reads the character. Use MBTI functions to shape attention and decision-making. They do not excuse an action or predetermine it. A useful note creates a more precise choice. A broad claim that any man or woman would behave the same way should be discarded. Story-pressure notes identify a possible payoff or image. They remain separate from confirmed scene facts. Doom v7: scope of the current notes Mikhail names the family connection in dialogue. Lynleit's cup handling, increasingly formal objections, and final threat convey her private discomfort. The notes address that performance without proposing a romantic pairing or a general rule about women. Earlier versions have their own paragraph anchors. The v7 restoration also lets Mikhail leave one averted glance unremarked. Its story-pressure note addresses the interruption of his teasing, without assigning him a new motive or romantic interest. Restored action beats preserve Lynleit's replies and the timing of the porcelain exchange. Park encounter and prequel direction The park notes concern adult Lynleit and Kyrien: spontaneous closeness after work, private preparation, the familiar flask, and a delayed comic consequence. Arc 0 notes remain tentative formation guidance and do not backdate adult intimate behavior into the younger cast’s school years. The hotel refuge remains nonsexual. Attention and type readings: 12 September 2026 The Cognition and Physical Competence reference separates the author's answers from type interpretation. Lynleit's INFJ and Felix's ENFP readings are suspected; Kyrien's ISTP lead has INTJ open. Sherie's ENFJ and strong Fe are confirmed. Older Chapter-version notes record the readings used at the time. Use those answers before a type stereotype. Lynleit consults others without automatically settling her private unease. Kyrien's quiet may contain continuing analysis, not complete understanding. Sherie plays socially even off duty and notices emotional change. Felix can reassure others while privately testing the interpretation he has offered. The hypothetical response to Sherie's hurt is not an established scene. Physical competence belongs to aptitude and acquired skill, not function order. No new paragraph marker is added where there is no actual paragraph or scene to annotate. After the Failed Attempt v3 The current interrogation dramatizes Kyrien's years of work, legal defeat, care for his mother, and guarded negotiation. The new paragraph notes are version-specific. His caution comes from experience with lawyers, not legal expertise or a rule about male stoicism. Lynleit's questions combine concealed anger, duty, guilt, and an intuitive need for an ally; care for his mother does not erase her leverage. Earlier outline notes remain scoped to v1 and v2. No type or capability score changes. Only Eyes for You In Only Eyes for You v2, Lynleit and Fionn visit churches with Felix and Reiner. Reiner behaves; Felix keeps flirting with the nuns until Lynleit loses patience. The F, M, and S notes address her accumulated irritation, his instinctive flattering reply, and the straight-person roles of Reiner and the nun. Her outburst is not jealousy. Fionn need not comment on it. V1 has its own draft and notes; the visits' purpose and exact placement before Fionn's death are undecided. river-operation The river operation nameless-street The Nameless Street relationships-under-pressure Relationships under pressure long-term-inheritance Long-term inheritance academy-crisis The Academy crisis cardiff-venture The Cardiff venture doom-address Doom Has an Address park-bench The bench under the lamp arc-zero Arc 0 development church-interlude Only Eyes for You river-lynleit river-operation female Lynleit Suspected INFJ, Ni-led reading with strong Fe Once Lynleit is ashore, the feeling of hands holding her down may linger even while she tries to give orders. Her later complaint about the jacket can be petty and heartfelt: she liked it and could not save it. the-empty-boats-beneath-the-bridge the-boat-beneath-the-bridge river-kyrien river-operation male Kyrien ISTP lean Keep Kyrien's answer literal and brief. He knows what he saw and chooses not to say it. His officer upbringing and watchfulness can appear in his attention to the search on the other bank. the-empty-boats-beneath-the-bridge the-boat-beneath-the-bridge river-maren river-operation female Maren Type unknown Maren is a trained officer, not a weaker swimmer. The horror lies in losing ownership of her own movement when hands seize her legs. Once ashore, a short sensory statement is more credible than a theory: she knows what fingers felt like, but does not claim to know who they belonged to. Anger or embarrassment at having needed to be hauled over the wall may surface after the immediate shock. the-empty-boats-beneath-the-bridge the-boat-beneath-the-bridge river-reiner river-operation male Reiner ISTJ with strong Si and Te Reiner's greater build makes him the practical anchor for Maren and Ivo, but the river prevents strength from solving the whole problem. He is likely to convert fear into tasks: secure the person, reach the wall, count the team, check the line. His later guilt would appear as stricter procedure and repeated equipment checks rather than a broad confession. the-empty-boats-beneath-the-bridge the-boat-beneath-the-bridge river-felix river-operation male Felix Suspected ENFP, habitual alternatives and personal loyalty Remaining ashore should frustrate Felix because his most valued people descend without him. His role is still decisive. He keeps the cameras frozen, hears the failure before he can see it, abandons the van at the correct moment, and turns a communications fallback into a physical rescue line. A joke after the extraction can be an attempt to restore ordinary human rhythm, not proof that he took the danger lightly. the-empty-boats-beneath-the-bridge the-boat-beneath-the-bridge river-blue-flame river-operation story Blue flame under the river Story-pressure suggestion The blue flame can expose the scale of the horror without an explanation. Hands burning in blue beneath the surface would briefly illuminate different ages, sizes, and states of decay before the river closes over them again. The image would let the reader understand that Lynleit is fighting accumulated dead rather than a single submerged attacker. the-empty-boats-beneath-the-bridge the-boat-beneath-the-bridge pressure-lynleit-interrogation relationships-under-pressure female Lynleit Suspected INFJ, Ni-led reading with strong Fe, MSF duty primary Lynleit's concealed knowledge that Kyrien nearly harmed her gives the interrogation a personal edge, but she does not make the injury the purpose of the scene. Her MSF responsibility and anticipation of a larger threat remain decisive. The private anger should appear through unusually exact questions, controlled distance, or refusal to explain herself rather than flirtation or an emotional confession. after-the-failed-attempt interrogation-after-the-failed-attempt v1 v2 pressure-lynleit-interrogation-v3 relationships-under-pressure female Lynleit Suspected INFJ with strong Fe; duty, guilt, and concealed anger Let the welfare check be a practical response to what she has just learned. It need not soften every later question or erase her wish to recruit him. Her attention to his mother's needs is not flirtation, and she must never threaten the mother to obtain cooperation. after-the-failed-attempt interrogation-after-the-failed-attempt v3 pressure-kyrien-family-v3 relationships-under-pressure male Kyrien Suspected ISTP; close observation, legal experience, and family care Keep his attention on the missed shift and the neighbour's availability as well as the questioning. His guarded replies come from this history, not an assumption that men cannot speak about distress. Let him follow competent advice rather than suddenly become an expert in law. after-the-failed-attempt interrogation-after-the-failed-attempt v3 pressure-lawyer-proof-v3 relationships-under-pressure story Truth without accountability Nasu advisory framework; professional competence and institutional refusal Keep the original and amended statement concrete enough for Kyrien and the reader to understand the legal achievement. The later closed review should defeat accountability without making the lawyer's work fraudulent or useless. Do not give every official the same knowledge of the magical reason. after-the-failed-attempt interrogation-after-the-failed-attempt v3 pressure-card-tells relationships-under-pressure story Cards and physical tells Approved sexual-tension pattern Keep the games brief and embedded in operational downtime. Kyrien should win more often through technical play, while Lynleit gains ground by reading him. Their attention becomes sexual because hands, breathing, gaze, and proximity begin to distract them, not because either character starts performing romance. Lynleit notices the intrusion and returns to the mission. the-empty-boats-beneath-the-bridge the-boat-beneath-the-bridge pressure-kyrien-voluntary-stay relationships-under-pressure male Kyrien ISTP lean, officer ethics and autonomy Kyrien's decision to remain must occur when departure is genuinely possible and Lynleit's original authority has lost practical force. He is unlikely to explain the choice romantically. Staying, accepting the danger, and reopening contact are enough to separate voluntary loyalty from the vigilance of a coerced asset. the-first-lines-back-into-msf pressure-kyrien-battle-reward relationships-under-pressure male Kyrien ISTP lean, competitive drive and paternal inheritance The answer should remain immediate and unadorned. Kyrien does not reassure Lynleit or make her the reward because he experiences the fight as a chance to test himself. The useful ambiguity lies in what he does not examine: choosing a battle repeatedly places him beside the same woman, even while he continues to describe the motive as his own. because-theres-a-battle-to-be-fought pressure-mikhail-aftermath relationships-under-pressure story The argument after Mikhail Approved relationship-pressure beat The argument remains about Kyrien exposing Felix and Reiner. Physical awareness belongs only in the delayed step apart and should not soften either position. Kyrien remains to help without apologizing, while Lynleit returns immediately to the institutional problem he has worsened. mikhail-discovers-the-breach nameless-lynleit nameless-street female Lynleit Suspected INFJ, Ni-led reading with strong Fe The crying girl works as a lure because Lynleit notices a vulnerable person and assumes responsibility before she can test the situation. This does not require a general claim that women are more nurturing. Her Fe-oriented leadership, strong symbolic intuition, and experience of being watched make the trap personal. Afterward she may be angrier that the street used her protective instinct than frightened by the child herself. the-nameless-street the-nameless-street nameless-felix nameless-street male Felix Suspected ENFP, habitual alternatives and personal loyalty Felix experiences an ordinary physical emergency while Lynleit experiences the impossible street. His first response is immediate and tactile: get close, make noise, fan her face, check whether she responds. Once she wakes, his familiarity gives him room to tease, but affection should make him notice that her explanation is not a performance. He can believe that something happened without pretending to understand it. the-nameless-street the-nameless-street pressure-helena relationships-under-pressure female Helena ENTJ with strong Te Helena's grievance against Fionn becomes stronger if it includes the private humiliation of being treated as a wife in public and a security risk in his deepest life. Her response remains character-specific: she turns exclusion into a structural problem to remove. She is not dangerous because resentment makes her emotional. She is dangerous because she can organize resentment into policy, access, and succession. fionn-is-eliminated pressure-fionn relationships-under-pressure male Fionn INTJ with strong Ni Fionn can sincerely believe that silence is a form of protection because his identity as father, husband, director, and Magiarch has trained him to equate love with containment. entries.text: Character Behaviour Audit · v2 Writer's Character Reference Advisory scene notes combining established characterization, physical circumstance, sex, social experience, and MBTI function emphasis without turning broad gender patterns into canon. Character Behaviour Audit This writer-facing record tests whether a reaction feels specific to the character who performs it. The notes combine established history, physical circumstances, sex, social expectations, and MBTI function emphasis. They are possibilities for the author to accept, reject, or revise. They are not canon until they enter a story record. How the audit works Begin with what the character already wants, fears, notices, and knows how to do. Use sex and social experience where the scene makes them materially relevant: physical leverage, clothing, public danger, expectations learned in childhood, or the way another person reads the character. Use MBTI functions to shape attention and decision-making. They do not excuse an action or predetermine it. A useful note creates a more precise choice. A broad claim that any man or woman would behave the same way should be discarded. Story-pressure notes identify a possible payoff or image. They remain separate from confirmed scene facts. river-operation The river operation nameless-street The Nameless Street relationships-under-pressure Relationships under pressure long-term-inheritance Long-term inheritance academy-crisis The Academy crisis cardiff-venture The Cardiff venture doom-address Doom Has an Address river-lynleit river-operation female Lynleit ENFJ with strong Ni Once Lynleit is ashore, the feeling of hands holding her down may linger even while she tries to give orders. Her later complaint about the jacket can be petty and heartfelt: she liked it and could not save it. the-empty-boats-beneath-the-bridge the-boat-beneath-the-bridge river-kyrien river-operation male Kyrien ISTP lean Keep Kyrien's answer literal and brief. He knows what he saw and chooses not to say it. His officer upbringing and watchfulness can appear in his attention to the search on the other bank. the-empty-boats-beneath-the-bridge the-boat-beneath-the-bridge river-maren river-operation female Maren Type unknown Maren is a trained officer, not a weaker swimmer. The horror lies in losing ownership of her own movement when hands seize her legs. Once ashore, a short sensory statement is more credible than a theory: she knows what fingers felt like, but does not claim to know who they belonged to. Anger or embarrassment at having needed to be hauled over the wall may surface after the immediate shock. the-empty-boats-beneath-the-bridge the-boat-beneath-the-bridge river-reiner river-operation male Reiner ISTJ with strong Si and Te Reiner's greater build makes him the practical anchor for Maren and Ivo, but the river prevents strength from solving the whole problem. He is likely to convert fear into tasks: secure the person, reach the wall, count the team, check the line. His later guilt would appear as stricter procedure and repeated equipment checks rather than a broad confession. the-empty-boats-beneath-the-bridge the-boat-beneath-the-bridge river-felix river-operation male Felix ESFP with strong Se and Fi Remaining ashore should frustrate Felix because his most valued people descend without him. His role is still decisive. He keeps the cameras frozen, hears the failure before he can see it, abandons the van at the correct moment, and turns a communications fallback into a physical rescue line. A joke after the extraction can be an attempt to restore ordinary human rhythm, not proof that he took the danger lightly. the-empty-boats-beneath-the-bridge the-boat-beneath-the-bridge river-blue-flame river-operation story Blue flame under the river Story-pressure suggestion The blue flame can expose the scale of the horror without an explanation. Hands burning in blue beneath the surface would briefly illuminate different ages, sizes, and states of decay before the river closes over them again. The image would let the reader understand that Lynleit is fighting accumulated dead rather than a single submerged attacker. the-empty-boats-beneath-the-bridge the-boat-beneath-the-bridge pressure-lynleit-interrogation relationships-under-pressure female Lynleit ENFJ with strong Ni, MSF duty primary Lynleit's concealed knowledge that Kyrien nearly harmed her gives the interrogation a personal edge, but she does not make the injury the purpose of the scene. Her MSF responsibility and anticipation of a larger threat remain decisive. The private anger should appear through unusually exact questions, controlled distance, or refusal to explain herself rather than flirtation or an emotional confession. after-the-failed-attempt interrogation-after-the-failed-attempt pressure-card-tells relationships-under-pressure story Cards and physical tells Approved sexual-tension pattern Keep the games brief and embedded in operational downtime. Kyrien should win more often through technical play, while Lynleit gains ground by reading him. Their attention becomes sexual because hands, breathing, gaze, and proximity begin to distract them, not because either character starts performing romance. Lynleit notices the intrusion and returns to the mission. the-empty-boats-beneath-the-bridge the-boat-beneath-the-bridge pressure-kyrien-voluntary-stay relationships-under-pressure male Kyrien ISTP lean, officer ethics and autonomy Kyrien's decision to remain must occur when departure is genuinely possible and Lynleit's original authority has lost practical force. He is unlikely to explain the choice romantically. Staying, accepting the danger, and reopening contact are enough to separate voluntary loyalty from the vigilance of a coerced asset. the-first-lines-back-into-msf pressure-kyrien-battle-reward relationships-under-pressure male Kyrien ISTP lean, competitive drive and paternal inheritance The answer should remain immediate and unadorned. His instinct may be to solve pressure alone because that resembles the officer ideal inherited from his father. A believable failure occurs when he withholds a burden that subordinates needed to understand, repeating Fionn's mistake in a different personality. academy-myka-survival academy-crisis story Myka earns the outcome Story-pressure suggestion Myka's eventual first-place graduation should be earned through decisions she makes during the Academy crisis, not granted because Natalia and Kyrien rescue her. His outsider status must also cost him: he cannot read magical danger directly and needs Myka or Natalia to interpret what his field instincts expose. terrors-inside-the-academy cardiff-mikhail-capability cardiff-venture male Father Mikhail XNJ lean, Church special envoy and confirmed counter-Magus field operative Mikhail's capability is strongest when the reader learns it through the decisions that keep him alive, not through a summary of techniques. Solitary endurance should expose what his Church training asks him to sacrifice, while at least one successful choice should become the reason Lynleit cannot dismiss his method as simple cruelty. father-mikhails-foreign-venture cardiff-moral-rift cardiff-venture story Two effective methods Nasu audit story-pressure suggestion The moral conflict should not make Lynleit naive or Mikhail a caricature. Each method needs to solve something the other cannot, and each needs a human cost the other recognizes. Their protection of one another remains professional and deliberate even while the disagreement makes later cooperation in Narvea harder. father-mikhails-foreign-venture inheritance-jacket-form long-term-inheritance story The jacket form Story-pressure suggestion The first time the leviathan-hide coat imitates Lynleit's lost suede jacket could occur when the resemblance is emotionally inconvenient. The form would turn an irritable complaint about clothing into posthumous evidence that Fionn noticed more of her ordinary preferences than his secrecy allowed him to say. the-coat-fionn-left-behind inheritance-coat-choice long-term-inheritance story Protection requires a choice Story-pressure suggestion The coat works best as protection with judgment rather than passive armour. Its need to be placed over a specific wound or person forces Lynleit to choose what she covers. Its autonomous form can inconvenience her, but the decision to protect remains hers. the-coat-fionn-left-behind doom-lynleit-method doom-address female Lynleit Canon behavior, ENFJ with strong Ni and MSF duty primary Lynleit rejects the fatal treatment and keeps looking. Her research is competent; discussing its sexual implication with Kyrien is where she becomes evasive. Do not repeat a defense of her leadership after each awkward response. doom-has-an-address doom-has-an-address v1 v2 doom-kyrien-answer doom-address male Kyrien Alternate Version 1 only Kyrien notices that Lynleit is behaving incorrectly, asks one direct question, and does not force the explanation she refuses. His eventual response is physical, deliberate, and chosen after he understands what she is asking. The notes combine established history, physical circumstances, sex, social expectations, and MBTI function emphasis. They are possibilities for the author to accept, reject, or revise. They are not canon until they enter a story record. How the audit works Begin with what the character already wants, fears, notices, and knows how to do. Use sex and social experience where the scene makes them materially relevant: physical leverage, clothing, public danger, expectations learned in childhood, or the way another person reads the character. Use MBTI functions to shape attention and decision-making. They do not excuse an action or predetermine it. A useful note creates a more precise choice. A broad claim that any man or woman would behave the same way should be discarded. Story-pressure notes identify a possible payoff or image. They remain separate from confirmed scene facts. entries.text: Character Behaviour Audit · v5 Writer's Character Reference Version-scoped F, M, and S advisory notes, including Mikhail's mock blessing and Lynleit's response in Doom v7. Character Behaviour Audit This writer-facing record tests whether a reaction feels specific to the character who performs it. The notes combine established history, physical circumstances, sex, social expectations, and MBTI function emphasis. They are possibilities for the author to accept, reject, or revise. They are not canon until they enter a story record. How the audit works Begin with what the character already wants, fears, notices, and knows how to do. Use sex and social experience where the scene makes them materially relevant: physical leverage, clothing, public danger, expectations learned in childhood, or the way another person reads the character. Use MBTI functions to shape attention and decision-making. They do not excuse an action or predetermine it. A useful note creates a more precise choice. A broad claim that any man or woman would behave the same way should be discarded. Story-pressure notes identify a possible payoff or image. They remain separate from confirmed scene facts. Doom v7: scope of the current notes The current notes cover Mikhail's mock-liturgical delivery and Lynleit's interrupted composure. They guide performance and reader inference, not a new romantic pairing or a general claim about women. The family connection is now named in dialogue. Her private discomfort is conveyed by the cup, increasingly formal objections, and final threat. The notes distinguish what the scene says from what the reader infers; suggested additions remain advisory. Earlier versions retain their own paragraph anchors and notes. The v7 restoration also lets Mikhail leave one averted glance unremarked. Its story-pressure note addresses the interruption of his teasing, without assigning him a new motive or romantic interest. Restored action beats preserve Lynleit's replies and the timing of the porcelain exchange. river-operation The river operation nameless-street The Nameless Street relationships-under-pressure Relationships under pressure long-term-inheritance Long-term inheritance academy-crisis The Academy crisis cardiff-venture The Cardiff venture doom-address Doom Has an Address river-lynleit river-operation female Lynleit ENFJ with strong Ni Once Lynleit is ashore, the feeling of hands holding her down may linger even while she tries to give orders. Her later complaint about the jacket can be petty and heartfelt: she liked it and could not save it. the-empty-boats-beneath-the-bridge the-boat-beneath-the-bridge river-kyrien river-operation male Kyrien ISTP lean Keep Kyrien's answer literal and brief. He knows what he saw and chooses not to say it. His officer upbringing and watchfulness can appear in his attention to the search on the other bank. the-empty-boats-beneath-the-bridge the-boat-beneath-the-bridge river-maren river-operation female Maren Type unknown Maren is a trained officer, not a weaker swimmer. The horror lies in losing ownership of her own movement when hands seize her legs. Once ashore, a short sensory statement is more credible than a theory: she knows what fingers felt like, but does not claim to know who they belonged to. Anger or embarrassment at having needed to be hauled over the wall may surface after the immediate shock. the-empty-boats-beneath-the-bridge the-boat-beneath-the-bridge river-reiner river-operation male Reiner ISTJ with strong Si and Te Reiner's greater build makes him the practical anchor for Maren and Ivo, but the river prevents strength from solving the whole problem. He is likely to convert fear into tasks: secure the person, reach the wall, count the team, check the line. His later guilt would appear as stricter procedure and repeated equipment checks rather than a broad confession. the-empty-boats-beneath-the-bridge the-boat-beneath-the-bridge river-felix river-operation male Felix ESFP with strong Se and Fi Remaining ashore should frustrate Felix because his most valued people descend without him. His role is still decisive. He keeps the cameras frozen, hears the failure before he can see it, abandons the van at the correct moment, and turns a communications fallback into a physical rescue line. A joke after the extraction can be an attempt to restore ordinary human rhythm, not proof that he took the danger lightly. the-empty-boats-beneath-the-bridge the-boat-beneath-the-bridge river-blue-flame river-operation story Blue flame under the river Story-pressure suggestion The blue flame can expose the scale of the horror without an explanation. Hands burning in blue beneath the surface would briefly illuminate different ages, sizes, and states of decay before the river closes over them again. The image would let the reader understand that Lynleit is fighting accumulated dead rather than a single submerged attacker. the-empty-boats-beneath-the-bridge the-boat-beneath-the-bridge pressure-lynleit-interrogation relationships-under-pressure female Lynleit ENFJ with strong Ni, MSF duty primary Lynleit's concealed knowledge that Kyrien nearly harmed her gives the interrogation a personal edge, but she does not make the injury the purpose of the scene. Her MSF responsibility and anticipation of a larger threat remain decisive. The private anger should appear through unusually exact questions, controlled distance, or refusal to explain herself rather than flirtation or an emotional confession. after-the-failed-attempt interrogation-after-the-failed-attempt pressure-card-tells relationships-under-pressure story Cards and physical tells Approved sexual-tension pattern Keep the games brief and embedded in operational downtime. Kyrien should win more often through technical play, while Lynleit gains ground by reading him. Their attention becomes sexual because hands, breathing, gaze, and proximity begin to distract them, not because either character starts performing romance. Lynleit notices the intrusion and returns to the mission. the-empty-boats-beneath-the-bridge the-boat-beneath-the-bridge pressure-kyrien-voluntary-stay relationships-under-pressure male Kyrien ISTP lean, officer ethics and autonomy Kyrien's decision to remain must occur when departure is genuinely possible and Lynleit's original authority has lost practical force. He is unlikely to explain the choice romantically. Staying, accepting the danger, and reopening contact are enough to separate voluntary loyalty from the vigilance of a coerced asset. the-first-lines-back-into-msf pressure-kyrien-battle-reward relationships-under-pressure male Kyrien ISTP lean, competitive drive and paternal inheritance The answer should remain immediate and unadorned. Kyrien does not reassure Lynleit or make her the reward because he experiences the fight as a chance to test himself. The useful ambiguity lies in what he does not examine: choosing a battle repeatedly places him beside the same woman, even while he continues to describe the motive as his own. because-theres-a-battle-to-be-fought pressure-mikhail-aftermath relationships-under-pressure story The argument after Mikhail Approved relationship-pressure beat The argument remains about Kyrien exposing Felix and Reiner. Physical awareness belongs only in the delayed step apart and should not soften either position. Kyrien remains to help without apologizing, while Lynleit returns immediately to the institutional problem he has worsened. mikhail-discovers-the-breach nameless-lynleit nameless-street female Lynleit ENFJ with strong Ni The crying girl works as a lure because Lynleit notices a vulnerable person and assumes responsibility before she can test the situation. This does not require a general claim that women are more nurturing. Her Fe-oriented leadership, strong symbolic intuition, and experience of being watched make the trap personal. Afterward she may be angrier that the street used her protective instinct than frightened by the child herself. the-nameless-street the-nameless-street nameless-felix nameless-street male Felix ESFP with strong Se and Fi Felix experiences an ordinary physical emergency while Lynleit experiences the impossible street. His first response is immediate and tactile: get close, make noise, fan her face, check whether she responds. Once she wakes, his familiarity gives him room to tease, but affection should make him notice that her explanation is not a performance. He can believe that something happened without pretending to understand it. the-nameless-street the-nameless-street pressure-helena relationships-under-pressure female Helena ENTJ with strong Te Helena's grievance against Fionn becomes stronger if it includes the private humiliation of being treated as a wife in public and a security risk in his deepest life. Her response remains character-specific: she turns exclusion into a structural problem to remove. She is not dangerous because resentment makes her emotional. She is dangerous because she can organize resentment into policy, access, and succession. fionn-is-eliminated pressure-fionn relationships-under-pressure male Fionn INTJ with strong Ni Fionn can sincerely believe that silence is a form of protection because his identity as father, husband, director, and Magiarch has trained him to equate love with containment. A masculine officer culture may reinforce the habit of carrying danger without asking family to share it. The flaw is not lack of feeling. It is his confidence that private endurance gives him the right to decide what everyone else may know. fionn-is-eliminated pressure-yulia relationships-under-pressure female Yulia ISTJ with strong Si Yulia's decision to follow Hiyu into the park can contain two competing reactions: procedural disgust at the trespass and a familiar expectation that she will be the one who prevents his idea from killing him. As a young woman beside a reckless male friend, she may resent being pushed into practical responsibility while still choosing it. Her care appears in preparation, correction, and staying present rather than an open admission of attraction. students-beyond-the-cordon pressure-hiyu relationships-under-pressure male Hiyu ENTP with strong Ne Hiyu's confidence in an elegant possibility may make the physical risk feel secondary until Yulia reacts to it. His eventual attachment should develop through dependence on the person who makes his ideas survivable. He does not need to become conventionally suave when desire appears. Confusion is more consistent if he recognizes that losing Yulia's company would be intolerable before he recognizes the feeling as romantic. students-beyond-the-cordon inheritance-kyrien long-term-inheritance male Kyrien Probable ISTP moving into command Directing MSF while Lynleit carries the Magiarchate forces Kyrien into a role built around speech, delegation, and institutional patience. His instinct may be to solve pressure alone because that resembles the officer ideal inherited from his father. A believable failure occurs when he withholds a burden that subordinates needed to understand, repeating Fionn's mistake in a different personality. academy-myka-survival academy-crisis story Myka earns the outcome Story-pressure suggestion Myka's eventual first-place graduation should be earned through decisions she makes during the Academy crisis, not granted because Natalia and Kyrien rescue her. Their help can keep her alive or give her access, but at least one decisive discovery, refusal, or use of magecraft should belong to Myka alone and expose a weakness that follows her into MSF. terrors-inside-the-academy academy-kyrien-outsider academy-crisis male Kyrien ISTP lean, non-Magus field operator Kyrien's usefulness inside the Academy should come from seeing an ordinary operational pattern that trained Magi dismiss because they are looking for a magecraft explanation. His outsider status must also cost him: he cannot read magical danger directly and needs Myka or Natalia to interpret what his field instincts expose. terrors-inside-the-academy cardiff-mikhail-capability cardiff-venture male Father Mikhail XNJ lean, Church special envoy and confirmed counter-Magus field operative Mikhail's capability is strongest when the reader learns it through the decisions that keep him alive, not through a summary of techniques. Solitary endurance should expose what his Church training asks him to sacrifice, while at least one successful choice should become the reason Lynleit cannot dismiss his method as simple cruelty. father-mikhails-foreign-venture cardiff-moral-rift cardiff-venture story Two effective methods Nasu audit story-pressure suggestion The moral conflict should not make Lynleit naive or Mikhail a caricature. Each method needs to solve something the other cannot, and each needs a human cost the other recognizes. Their protection of one another remains professional and deliberate even while the disagreement makes later cooperation in Narvea harder. father-mikhails-foreign-venture inheritance-jacket-form long-term-inheritance story The jacket form Story-pressure suggestion The first time the leviathan-hide coat imitates Lynleit's lost suede jacket could occur when the resemblance is emotionally inconvenient. The form would turn an irritable complaint about clothing into posthumous evidence that Fionn noticed more of her ordinary preferences than his secrecy allowed him to say. the-coat-fionn-left-behind inheritance-coat-choice long-term-inheritance story Protection requires a choice Story-pressure suggestion The coat works best as protection with judgment rather than passive armour. Its need to be placed over a specific wound or person forces Lynleit to choose what she covers. Its autonomous form can inconvenience her, but the decision to protect remains hers. the-coat-fionn-left-behind doom-lynleit-method doom-address female Lynleit Canon behavior, ENFJ with strong Ni and MSF duty primary Lynleit rejects the fatal treatment and keeps looking.
